# Step - export_snapshot

`export_snapshot` · category: [Graph information and files](../../traversal/step_reference.md#graph-information-and-files)

Writes the whole graph to a packed snapshot file (.gsnap) at the given path (needs file access).

## Forms

```text
export_snapshot(arg1: string)
```

## Example

```rhai
g.export_snapshot("modern.gsnap")
```

## See also

- [Packed Snapshots](../../persistence/packed_snapshots.md)
